lines.text: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah son of Berechiah.
The LORD was very angry with the fathers, and He told the people to return to Him.
The LORD of Hosts said that if the people return to Him, He will bless them.
The former prophets told the fathers to turn from their evil ways, but the fathers did not listen.
God's words and statutes overtook the fathers, and they said the LORD had done what He refused to do.
